title: Jodi No.1
desc: Partners in crime Jai and Veeru set their next target on a rich businessman, Rai Bahadur. Things turn hilarious when they both fall for his daughters.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

title: Annapoorani : The Goddess Of Food
desc: Born into an orthodox Hindu family, Annapoorani dreams of becoming a top chef. Battling prejudice and rigid traditions, she must break barriers to pursue her passion and redefine her destiny.

title: Kahaani 2: Durga Rani Singh
desc: As Inspector Inderjeet investigates the car accident, he discovers that Vidya Sinha may not be all she appears. She has a dark past linking her to Durga Rani Singh.

title: Ghatak: Lethal
desc: Kashi witnesses the brutal rule of Katya during a visit with his father. As he dares to resist the oppression, his actions endanger the lives of his family and loved ones.

title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
desc: Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
desc: Raj and Priya hire Madhubala as a surrogate. But when Madhubala falls for Raj and claims the child as her own, love, betrayal, and chaos turn their lives upside down.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Aakhri Raasta
desc: After 24 years behind bars for a crime he didn't commit, David is free but shocked to find his former accusers now thriving as respected citizens in society.

title: Desh Premee
desc: Master Dinanath, a freedom fighter, flees his village with his son Raju and finds refuge with four crooks. Unaware of their deceit, he strives to reform and unite them.

title: Saaransh
desc: A retired teacher and his wife struggle with grief after losing their only son to a tragic mugging. Slowly, they learn to find peace, holding on to memories and each other.

title: Mili
desc: Mili Naudiyal works in a restaurant while preparing to move to Canada. Her life turns into a survival battle when she's accidentally locked inside a freezer.

title: Crew
desc: Three cabin crew friends find themselves in a tough spot when an unknown schemer throws a wrench in their plans. Can they uncover the truth and save the day?

title: Baadshah
desc: Desperate for a major career breakthrough, private investigator Raj accepts a hostage recovery mission, only to stumble straight into the center of a massive political plot.

title: Virgin Bhanupriya
desc: Bhanupriya, a conservative woman, repeatedly fails in her attempts to lose her virginity, but after a fortune teller declares it impossible, she becomes even more determined to prove otherwise.

title: 2.0 Robot
desc: When mobile phones mysteriously fly from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and Nila investigate. To stop Pakshi Rajan's chaos, they must revive Chitti for a decisive battle.
